tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Estimates for a limiting reduced distance] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0172 ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-quadratic-upper-growth ↗ cor:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-derivative-bounds ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-i-reduced-distance-lower-bound ↗ thm:chow-iv-singular-time-reduced-distance-limit 1. ch30:30.18\group Singular-Time Reduced Volume

Under the Type I hypotheses of Theorem 2, for every positive time margin there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ \frac{d_{g_\infty (t)}(x,p_\infty )^2}{C(\omega _\infty -t)}-C \leq \ell _\infty (x,t)\leq \frac{C d_{g_\infty (t)}(x,p_\infty )^2}{\omega _\infty -t}+C, \] \[ |\nabla \ell _\infty |\leq C\left((\omega _\infty -t)^{-1/2} +\frac{d_{g_\infty (t)}(x,p_\infty )}{\omega _\infty -t}\right), \] and $|\partial _t\ell _\infty |$ has the corresponding quadratic growth. The same estimates hold for a single Type I solution.
